helpful: The statpack's CVSG cut and the per-Term salience-band `reached` table gave a clean pre-adjustment anchor for a CVSG-moment cell.
Provisioned petition/BIO text made the vehicle-argument read possible without any fetching.
gaps: No sanctioned way to read the current supremecourt.gov docket: the CourtListener MCP has no entries for SCOTUS dockets and supremecourt.gov blocks fetches (403). For a forward CVSG cell whose snapshot is seven months old, the post-snapshot docket (abeyance motion, SG brief status) was the decisive input and had to come from secondary reporting.

fedcourts corpus-info is not runnable inside a cell (ranged backend lacks the remote URL), so the corpus-vintage line the golden rules ask for cannot be produced as documented; query rows' last_live_polled was the fallback.
notes: Retrieval stayed well under budget (~9 calls). The statpack has no cut for petitions that settle while a CVSG is pending; the dismissal-path mass is judgment.
